name: Crown of Convergence — your creatures that share a color with the creature card on top get +1/+1
notes: The condition tested the creature being changed, and "that share a color with that card" was read as subtypes Share and Color, so nothing got the boost. Kitchen Finks is green and white. The opponent's Crown has a noncreature card on top and gives nothing.

scryfallData.name: Crown of Convergence
